name: Mythical Caches and Mythic Keystones run out while their owner is logged off (#7724)
contract: #7724: a Mythical Cache (24 h) and a Mythic Keystone (7 days) only aged while their owner was logged in, so
logging off kept them forever. Both now count down in real time: after an hour offline the cache and the key
each have an hour less left, and after more than a day offline the cache is gone while the key remains.

steps.label: SETUP: a fresh cache has 24 h
SETUP: a fresh keystone has 7 days
the cache lost the hour spent offline
the keystone lost the hour spent offline
the cache ran out while its owner was offline
the keystone is still there with 25 h less
